messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "ensure family or caregiver knows which symptoms may be serious"
set: ["ensure family or caregiver knows which symptoms may be serious", "family or caregivers should be alert to changes in mood or symptoms", "family or caregivers should monitor mood or symptoms", "symptoms usually not serious", "measles can be serious or fatal", "chickenpox can be serious or fatal", "these may be signs of a serious condition", "tell family members or caregivers which symptoms to watch for so they can call provider if not able to", "be sure your doctor knows if you also use", "caregiver should be trained before first dose", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver", "may be habit-forming", "combination cold or nighttime products which may contain antihistamines or other sedating ingredients", "stopping abruptly can cause serious withdrawal symptoms", "doctor may occasionally change dose to ensure best results", "symptoms may occur with or without using medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
